messages:
samir: quick check: i'm cleaning up how our SDKs map API error responses into language exceptions and how we log/propagate request ids. testing across node/go/python. main goals: 1) deterministic exception types (e.g., BadRequest, AuthError, RateLimit) 2) include request id in the exception and all debug logs 3) keep streaming reconnect semantics sane (where do we attach the rid?) 4) avoid leaking internal json blobs in user-facing error messages

marta: +1 on types. wdyt about attaching a `request_id` field on the exception object rather than embedding in message? easier to program against.

elaine: agree. also strongly prefer not to stringify raw api body in message. put full body in debug logger with rid and keep error.message concise.

ben: for go sdk note: we currently wrap errors with errors.Wrapf("api error: %s", body) — that loses structured fields. propose an APIError struct: 
```
type APIError struct {
  Status int
  Code string
  Message string
  ReqID string
}
func (e *APIError) Error() string { return fmt.Sprintf("%d %s", e.Status, e.Message) }
```
then callers can inspect ReqID. PR 4567 has a prototype.

samir: exactly. node prototype uses `class APIError extends Error { constructor(status, code, message, reqId, raw){ super(message); this.status=... } }` and we attach `error.reqId`.

marta: streaming question: when a streaming connection drops and we resume client-side, do we emit a single error with the original rid or a new rid for the reconnect? my take: keep the original rid for the overall request, but log a reconnect sub-event with new internal id. user-visible errors should include the original rid.

elaine: agreed. also in logs use keys: rid, span_id, attempt. keeps cross-service tracing easy. debug logger example:
```
logger.debug("llm stream dropped", { rid: reqId, attempt: 2, upstream_error: body })
```

ben: +1. small node quirk: streaming SDK currently throws an `AbortError` on disconnect without attaching rid. will update to wrap: `new StreamDisconnectedError(reqId, cause)`.

samir: ok next steps: ben — can you push the go struct PR diff to link in PR 4567? marta/elaine — can you review node error class PR (4568) and confirm message content policy? i'll add a cross-sdk test that asserts `err.reqId` exists and that `error.message` excludes raw json.

devex-bot: deployment note: canary for SDK error-changes scheduled tonight 2300 UTC. watch logs for `err.reqId` tag.

marta: ping @ben please for the code review ;)

ben: on it :eyes: will push updates by EOD and tag reviewers.

samir: thanks all — i'll file a small doc snippet in /docs/sdk/error-guidelines.md after merges. :shipit:
